BackstoryDef.title: unknown
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: As [PAWN_nameDef] is a transhuman organism captured and subdued by the Combine, with [PAWN_possessive] basic identity completely erased via brainwashing, little is known about [PAWN_possessive] childhood.

BackstoryDef.title: combine grunt
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Having been captured by or voluntarily submitted to the Combine at some point in the past, [PAWN_nameDef] was once a normal human with a name and identity. Subjected to moderate surgical augmentation, basic cybernetic implants, and relentless mental conditioning, [PAWN_nameDef] was transformed into a Grunt-class infantry operative. Though some human traits remain, most of [PAWN_possessive] former self was suppressed beneath layers of obedience and control.

BackstoryDef.title: combine soldier
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Having been captured by or voluntarily submitted to the Combine at some point in the past, [PAWN_nameDef] was once a normal human with a name and identity. [PAWN_nameDef] was subjected to a variety of invasive surgical procedures and aggressive brainwashing, destroying most physical and mental semblances of humanity [PAWN_possessive] possessed beforehand.

BackstoryDef.title: combine ordinal
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Having been captured by or voluntarily submitted to the Combine at some point in the past, [PAWN_nameDef] was once a normal human with a name and identity. Selected for field command duties, [PAWN_nameDef] underwent standard transhuman conversion followed by neural augmentation, tactical integration implants, and chain-of-command conditioning. Designated as an Ordinal-class overseer, [PAWN_pronoun] acted as a combat coordinator and squad-level enforcer. Whatever identity [PAWN_possessive] once had was suppressed beneath layers of behavioral programming and Combine protocol.

BackstoryDef.title: combine elite
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Having been captured by or voluntarily submitted to the Combine at some point in the past, [PAWN_nameDef] was once a normal human with a name and identity. Selected for elite Overwatch integration, [PAWN_nameDef] underwent extensive transhuman conditioning, cortical remapping, and combat optimization. Outfitted with advanced armor and armed with Combine pulse technology, [PAWN_pronoun] became one of the regime’s most formidable enforcers. Whatever remained of [PAWN_possessive] former self was erased in the process.

BackstoryDef.title: combine assassin
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Having been captured by or voluntarily submitted to the Combine at some point in the past, [PAWN_nameDef] was once a normal human with a name and identity. Now repurposed into an elite Assassin-class operative, [PAWN_nameDef] underwent extreme cybernetic augmentation, reflex enhancement, and sensory reconditioning. Synthetic musculature and precision targeting implants turned [PAWN_objective] into a swift, silent killer. Aggressive brainwashing erased nearly all traces of humanity [PAWN_possessive] once had.

BackstoryDef.title: combine suppressor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Having been captured by or voluntarily submitted to the Combine at some point in the past, [PAWN_nameDef] was once a normal human with a name and identity. Now classified as a Suppressor-type unit, [PAWN_nameDef] was subjected to a variety of invasive surgical procedures, including full-body armor integration, neural targeting enhancements, and weapon-linked sensory conditioning. Aggressive brainwashing destroyed most physical and mental semblances of humanity [PAWN_possessive] possessed beforehand.

BackstoryDef.title: combine charger
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Having been captured by or voluntarily submitted to the Combine at some point in the past, [PAWN_nameDef] was once a normal human with a name and identity. Now classified as a Wallhammer-type unit, [PAWN_nameDef] was subjected to a variety of invasive surgical procedures, including heavy armor grafting, neural aggression amplification, and the integration of vocal distortion vectors. Aggressive brainwashing further destroyed most physical and mental semblances of humanity [PAWN_possessive] possessed beforehand.
